cases.command:
ASSERT (:alice, "prefers", :dark_mode) {
  by: :alice,              // REQUIRED semantic actor → asserted_by
  mode: "stated",          // REQUIRED: observed|stated|inferred|predicted|hypothetical|imported
  confidence: 0.95,        // optional [0,1]: strength of THIS stance, not truth probability
  evidence: :msg,          // optional: Evidence ref or array (runtime-ingested preferred)
  stance: "support",       // optional, default support (support|reject|uncertain)
  at: :time,               // optional → asserted_at (default: engine transaction time)
  valid: {from: :t1, until: :t2},   // optional → valid_time (world-valid interval)
  key: :client_key         // optional retry-safe identity
}

SEARCH CONCEPT :term
WITH TYPE :type
MODE "hybrid"
THRESHOLD :threshold
LIMIT :limit

FIND(?a.confidence, COUNT(DISTINCT ?p)) WHERE { ?p (?s, "a"|"b"{1,3}, ?o) ?a ASSERTION {proposition: ?p} FILTER(?a.confidence >= 0.5 && !IS_NULL(?s)) NOT { ?x {type: "Y"} } OPTIONAL { ?e EVIDENCE {evidence_class: "message"} } UNION { ?z {type: "Z"} } } AS OF SEQ :seq FOR TIME :t WITH EPISTEMIC {explain: "full", n: [1,:p]} ORDER BY ?a.confidence DESC, ?p LIMIT :l CURSOR :c
FIND(?b, ?slot) WHERE { ?b BELIEF (id: "P-1") ?slot BELIEF SLOT (:alice, "timezone") ?c BELIEF (?s, :pred, ?o) }
ASSERT ?a (:alice, "prefers", :dark) { by: :alice, mode: "stated", stance: "reject", confidence: 0.5, at: :now, valid: {from: :f}, evidence: [:e1, "E-2"], key: "k1" } SUPERSEDING :old

MUTATE { CREATE CONCEPT ?c { TYPE "Person" CLIENT KEY "k" NAME "Alice" SET FIELDS {a: 1} SET ATTRIBUTES {b: [1,:p]} SET FACET "F" {x: 1} SET STRUCTURAL { ("rel", ?c) {index: 0} } } UPSERT CONCEPT ?d { MATCH {key: "kk"} UNSET ATTRIBUTES {a, "b"} UNSET FACET "F" {x} UNSET STRUCTURAL { ("rel", ?c) } } EXPECT VERSION :v }
TRANSITION :act TO "completed" SET FIELDS {ended_at: :now} SET STRUCTURAL { ("outputs", :o) } EXPECT VERSION 2
PURGE :x WHERE { ?x {type: "T"} } LIMIT 5 REFERENCE POLICY "detach" CONFIRM "PURGE"
MERGE CONCEPT :js INTO :javascript WHERE { ?js {type: "T"} } EXPECT VERSION 2
SET RETENTION :x { retention_class: "short", expires_at: :t } WHERE { ?x {type: "T"} } LIMIT 3 EXPECT VERSION 1
TRANSITION ?a TO "retracted" WHERE { ?a ASSERTION {id: "A-1"} } LIMIT 1 EXPECT VERSION :v
TRANSITION :x TO "archived" WHERE { ?x {type: "T"} } LIMIT 2 EXPECT VERSION 3 OF ATTRIBUTES EXPECT VERSION 1 OF STRUCTURAL
DESCRIBE SCHEMA ENVIRONMENT AS OF SEQ 1
SEARCH CONCEPT "x" WITH TYPE "T" WITH PREDICATE "p" MODE "hybrid" THRESHOLD 0.5 AS OF SEQ 3 LIMIT 2 CURSOR :c
HISTORY ELEMENT "E" FROM SEQ 1 TO SEQ 2 LIMIT 3 CURSOR :c
EXPORT CAPSULE :out WHERE { ?c {type: "T"} (?c, "p", ?o) } WITH {redact: true} AS OF SEQ :seq
PURGE :e WHERE { ?e EVIDENCE {id: "E-1"} } LIMIT 1 EXPECT VERSION 2 REFERENCE POLICY "deny_if_referenced" CONFIRM "PURGE"
PURGE PAYLOAD :e EXPECT VERSION 2 OF RETENTION CONFIRM "PURGE"

UPDATE :skill SET ATTRIBUTES {status: "adopted"} SET FACET "GradingState" {graded_count: 12} EXPECT VERSION :va OF ATTRIBUTES EXPECT VERSION 0 OF FACET "GradingState" EXPECT VERSION :vr OF RETENTION EXPECT VERSION :v
ASSERT ?closed (:alice, "timezone", "+08:00") { by: :alice, mode: "stated", valid: {from: :since, until: :moved_at}, evidence: :msg } SUPERSEDING :a_old
DESCRIBE SCHEMA ENVIRONMENT AS OF SEQ :s
MERGE CONCEPT :a INTO :b EXPECT VERSION 1 OF ATTRIBUTES
DEFINE CONCEPT TYPE "Instrument" { description: "A musical instrument.", attributes: { open: true, fields: { family: { type: "string" } } } }
FIND(?x.name, ?x.retrieval.score) WHERE { ?x SEARCH CONCEPT "Alice" WITH TYPE "Person" MODE "keyword" THRESHOLD 0.2 LIMIT 5 ?b BELIEF (?x, "lives_in", ?city) }
FIND(?a) WHERE { ?a SEARCH ASSERTION :term WITH PREDICATE "prefers" LIMIT :k }

ASSERT (:alice, "prefers", :dark) { by: :alice, mode: "stated", context: [:work, :night], at: "2026-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", valid: {from: {earliest: "2025-01-01T00:00:00.000Z", latest: "2025-12-31T23:59:59.999Z"}} }
